# Bricks

> Listing media for Canadian real estate — HDR photography, licensed drone, floor plans, with optional virtual tour (path-confined) and virtual visit (free-roam Gaussian splat). Book a shoot in 24–48h, serving agents at Canada's leading brokerages and REITs.

Bricks is a real estate media company operated by Bricks Group in Canada. Agents and brokerages book listing photo/video/drone shoots online; Bricks delivers edited media within 24–48 hours. Current coverage: Toronto, Mississauga, Hamilton, Durham, York, and Niagara.

Two spatial products, never collapsed: **virtual tour** is a path-confined walkthrough; **virtual visit** is a Gaussian splat (SuperSplat), free-roam, never called a tour, always a paid add-on, never packaged.

## Core pages

- [Pricing](https://www.brxs.ca/pricing): À-la-carte pricing for HDR photography, drone, floor plans, twilight, virtual tour, and virtual visit (quoted by sqft — same footprint bands, no published dollar table).
- [Book a shoot](https://www.brxs.ca/book): Online booking flow with MLS auto-fill and instant pricing.
- [Gallery](https://www.brxs.ca/gallery): Sample listing photography from Bricks.
- [Service areas](https://www.brxs.ca/service-areas): Current city coverage in Canada.
- [Photographers](https://www.brxs.ca/photographers): Independent contractor network — apply to shoot for Bricks.
- [Terms](https://www.brxs.ca/terms): Client booking terms and cancellation schedule.
- [Privacy](https://www.brxs.ca/privacy): How Bricks Group handles personal information.
- [About](https://www.brxs.ca/about): Company background.
- [Contact](https://www.brxs.ca/contact): Get in touch.
